_id: The book's 第五回 to 第八回 (story/jiuding-lu/05-第五回.md … 08-第八回.md; once 第一章 · 外门, then 第三回 until 2026-09-30), between the prologue and 冀: an id that sorts after 00-prologue and before 01-ji (chapters run in id order, core.mjs advanceChapter).
_map: The small area around 沉鼎观 (his, 2026-09-29): 外门, 讲堂, 柴房, 药园, 后山, 藏经阁, 坊市, 渡口, the Si and its stone door, 泗水北岸. Every other place — the rest of 徐 and the eight provinces — refuses with `say` and stands greyed on the map (world.mjs mapOf).

say.zh: 外门弟子，无令不得下山。周衡的账本上，每一步都记着。
say.en: Outer disciples may not leave the mountain without leave. Every step goes in Zhou Heng's ledger.

_beats: 剧情 × 开放世界 (design.md, his 2026-09-28): five key beats lock the map from the scene after their entry to their last (world.mjs beatOf); between them the area is open, with the threads in quests/xu.json. The entry of each is a waypoint the player walks to.

say.zh: 讲堂还没散，夜还没过。先把眼前的事做完。
say.en: The lesson isn't over, nor the night. Finish what is before you first.

say.zh: 你一身是伤，哪儿也去不了。
say.en: You are hurt all over; you are going nowhere.

say.zh: 秘境的石门在身后合上了。三天后才开。
say.en: The stone door has shut behind you. It opens again in three days.

say.zh: 大比正在进行，台下三百双眼睛。
say.en: The contest is on, and three hundred pairs of eyes are watching.
Elder Qu is still waiting for you.

_goal: The chapter's one goal and its countdown on the goal line (errands.mjs goalOf): the story's date until 周衡's notice 「外门大比，明日」 (the mark `dabi-eve`, on wm-chu's rest), then 明日. No real-day wait any more (2026-09-30): the eve is a scene in the story (wm-qianye, 大比前夜 — the book's 第八回 § 一, and the rumour of 马家's trees), and the contest follows it at once.

date.en: the eighth of the twelfth month

_title: The arc's own name, no number: the player is told the 回 (卷一 · 第五回 … 第八回, book.json via the scenes' `hui`, rules/hui.mjs).
_close: The ending card on the stage once the chapter is over and the next one waits (story.mjs closeOf): 「第八回 · 完」 for the 回 it ends on (rules/hui.mjs, never written here), one line of what THIS player did — each `did` part whose `if` holds on the save (cast · owed · not; none: always), joined — and the next chapter's teaser in the book's voice.

did.zh: 你收了药园那只偷萝卜的小狰
did.en: You took in the little Zheng that robbed the herb garden
The garden thief got away from you

did.zh: 大比把第一轮让给了孙二狗
did.en: gave the contest's first round to Sun Ergou

did.zh: 大比一轮一轮打了上去
did.en: fought the contest round by round

did.zh: 终究赢下了那颗筑基丹
did.en: won the Foundation pill in the end

did.zh: 又拜了扫了五十年台阶的瞿老为师
did.en: and became the student of Elder Qu, who swept the steps for fifty years

teaser.zh: 却说头场雪下来的那一夜，观主亲手赐的那只玉盒子，沈小满已揣了三天，还没打开——他不是舍不得那道封条，他是在算一笔账。
teaser.en: Now on the night the first snow fell, Shen Xiaoman had carried the jade box the abbot gave him for three days and still not opened it — not that he couldn't bear to break the seal; he was doing a sum.

summary.zh: 外门的日子，是从交钱开始的。褚先生说杂灵根是漏勺；那天夜里，你一夜通了小周天——银月替你凿了两道半。柴房里二十三下，换来一只小铜炉；药园的贼不认字，吃了你的萝卜；沉鼎秘境里一撮息壤，撑开了你的五扇门。外门大比，马小宝在泗水里转了三圈。扫了五十年台阶的瞿老，收你为徒。
summary.en: Outer-court life starts with paying up. Master Chu says mixed roots are a skimmer; that night your qi goes round the small circuit in one go — Yinyue had chiselled two and a half gates for you. Twenty-three blows in the woodshed buy a little bronze furnace; the garden thief can't read, and eats your radish; a pinch of breathing soil in the hidden realm opens your five doors. At the contest Ma Xiaobao spins three times into the Si. Elder Qu, who swept the steps for fifty years, takes you as his student.

intro.zh: 外门的日子，是从交钱开始的。
intro.en: Life in the outer court starts with paying up.

_mystery: The riddle hints until the 秘境 is behind him: 息壤 is named only once wm-xirang is passed (story.mjs mysteryOf).

mystery.zh: 泗水底下的秘境，人人手里一张地图。地图上没画的地方，有什么？
mystery.en: Everyone who enters the realm under the Si carries a map. What lies where the map shows nothing?

mystery_after.zh: 三百年没人进过的石室里，为什么放着一撮息壤？
mystery_after.en: Why was there a pinch of breathing soil in a stone chamber no one had entered in three hundred years?
